scope: support conversations opened within 30 days of account signup

examples.summary: User asked which Business Manager and ad account should be selected for an existing client.
examples.resolution: Support explained the recommended account configuration. User completed connection later the same day.

examples.summary: User was unsure whether both page and ad-account permissions were required.
examples.resolution: Support sent configuration instructions. Connection completed.

examples.summary: User asked whether connecting GrowthOS could pause, edit, or duplicate campaigns already running in the client account.
examples.resolution: Support explained that connection alone does not modify existing campaigns. User continued setup.

examples.summary: Marketer did not have admin access to the client's Business Manager and needed the client to grant additional permissions.
examples.resolution: Waiting for client. No connection completion recorded at thread close.

examples.summary: OAuth returned an error after account selection.
User expected existing campaigns to appear automatically after connection and did not know whether to import or recreate them.
examples.resolution: Support explained current workflow. User did not launch during the support thread.

limitations: Themes are not mutually exclusive; one thread may appear in more than one theme.
Users who contact support may differ systematically from users who silently abandon.
A support resolution followed by activation does not establish that the support response caused activation.
Support tagging was performed retrospectively from conversation summaries.
